test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: According to ICRA, India’s general insurance sector is expected to see a growth of how much percentage in FY26?
solution:
The correct answer is __**8.7%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to a report by the credit rating agency **ICRA**, India’s **general insurance sector** is expected to grow by around **8.7%** in **FY26**.
 
• The projected growth is driven by rising demand in segments such as **health insurance**, **motor insurance**, and increasing awareness of risk coverage.
 
• Improved **digital distribution channels**, expansion of insurance products, and better penetration in semi-urban and rural markets are also expected to support growth.
 
• The growth estimate reflects the overall increase in **Gross Direct Premium Income (GDPI)** in the non-life insurance segment.
 
• This projection indicates steady expansion of India’s insurance market as the country aims to increase **insurance penetration** and financial protection.
 
• ***Hence, the correct option is 3.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **General Insurance**

 
 
• Also known as **non-life insurance**.
 
• Covers risks related to **health**, **motor vehicles**, **property**, **travel**, and **liability**.
 
 
 
• **ICRA (Investment Information and Credit Rating Agency)**
 
 
• Established in **1991**.
 
• Provides **credit ratings**, research, and risk analysis for financial markets.
 
• Headquartered in **Gurugram, Haryana**.
 
 
 
• **Insurance Regulation in India**
 
 
• Regulated by the **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)**.
 
• The authority promotes **insurance penetration** and protects the interests of policyholders.
